blocks.arabic_text: وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اْلاَسَدِ وَاْلاَرْقَمِ بْنِ أَبِي اْلاَرْقَمِ، فَأَسْلَمُوا ﵃.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Aishah (RA) reports: “Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) was a friend of Rasulullah ﷺ in the period of ignorance. One day he set out from his house with the intention of meeting Rasulullah ﷺ. When he met the Prophet ﷺ, he said, “Abul Qasim, (this is the kunyah of Rasulullah ﷺ) you are not to be seen in the gatherings of your people! They accuse you of finding fault with the forefathers of your people”. Rasulullah ﷺ said, “I am the Messenger of Allah Ta'ala; I call you to Allah Ta'ala”. As soon as Rasulullah ﷺ finished his words, Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) accepted Islam. The Prophet ﷺ went back from Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA). No one among the people between the two mountains of Makkah would have been as happy about any other matter as the Prophet ﷺ was happy at Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) embracing Islam. From there Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) set out to invite Hazrat Uthman ibn Affan, Hazrat Talhah ibn Ubaidullah, Hazrat Zubair ibn Awwam and Hazrat Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas (RA) to Islam. They too embraced Islam. The next day Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA), taking Hazrat Uthman ibn Maz'un, Hazrat Abu Ubaidah ibn Jarrah, Hazrat Abdur Rahman ibn Awf, Hazrat Abu Salamah ibn Abdul Asad and Hazrat Arqam ibn Abil Arqam (RA) with him,
